admissible_dim_method: subset sums of deg(irreducible factors of x^n-1 over F_2)
stage2_not_authorized: n in {23,31} + random-Boolean null require a later decision
structural_note: If ell is not an admissible φ-invariant dimension at n, the cell is E-NO-TAU-CLOSED-AT-ELL and the ≥1.25 band does not apply.
tau_closed_definition: V is φ-invariant as an F_2-subspace of F_{2^n}, equivalently (in a normal basis) a circulant code / ideal of F_2[x]/(x^n-1). Construction by saturating a seed under x |-> x^2.
